description: This file defines functions and regex patterns for handling glob pattern matching, including conversion to regex, validation of patterns and paths, and includes test cases. It also contains extensive signal and vehicle component signal definitions in comments.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Enumeration for regex error types, currently only RegexError.

methods.name: to_regex_string
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern string into a regex pattern string, handling wildcards and special patterns.

methods.name: to_regex
methods.description: Compiles a glob pattern into a Regex object, returning an Error if invalid.

methods.name: is_valid_pattern
methods.description: Checks if a pattern string matches the valid pattern regex.

methods.name: is_valid_path
methods.description: Checks if a path string matches the valid path regex.
